question: What impurity period is prescribed at the death of sons, O best twice-born?
premises: The case concerns the departure of sons.
The prescribed period is a fortnight.
The address is to the best of the twice-born.
inference: At the death of sons, the impurity period is a fortnight.
plain_english: And at the departure of sons, O best of the twice-born, that period is a fortnight.
